title: AI for Telecommunications
focus: Intelligent wireless systems, network analytics, signal classification, network quality prediction, dan AI-assisted telecommunications operations.
shortDescription: Jalur spesialisasi analitik jaringan nirkabel, klasifikasi kualitas sinyal radio (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR vs SNR), deteksi anomali trafik, dan alokasi sumber daya berbantuan AI.
learningOutcomes: Menganalisis dataset telemetri jaringan nirkabel dan membedakan secara teknis metrik SNR vs SINR, RSRP, RSRQ, Latency, Throughput, dan Packet Loss.
Membangun model klasifikasi kualitas sinyal dan prediksi throughput/latensi jaringan bebas kebocoran data.
Mendeteksi anomali trafik dan klaster gangguan sel menggunakan clustering dan ensemble learning.
Menyimulasikan alokasi sumber daya nirkabel berbasis Reinforcement Learning tanpa mengendalikan jaringan produksi.
Mengaudit explainability model jaringan dan memantau pergeseran distribusi trafik (drift).

capstone.title: Intelligent Wireless Network Quality Monitoring
capstone.summary: Merancang model prediksi atau klasifikasi kualitas jaringan nirkabel (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, SNR, Latency, Throughput, Packet Loss) beserta explainability dan drift monitoring di dataset sintetis/berlisensi.

references.title: O'Shea & Hoydis (2017), An Introduction to Deep Learning for the Physical Layer
3GPP TS 38.215, NR Physical Layer Measurements (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR Definitions)
Luong et al. (2019), Applications of Deep Reinforcement Learning in Communications and Networking
